assertions.assertion: The claim was denied with denial reason code CO-50.
The service in question is CPT 93229.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
There is a clinical indication note documenting the patient's condition.
The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat.
These symptoms are concerning for arrhythmia.
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The diagnosis codes are I34.0 and R00.2.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptoms with potential cardiac events over an extended monitoring period.
The payer stated that the documentation did not sufficiently establish the requirement for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
A request for reconsideration is being made (appeal rights exist).
